body:
### What happened

In a Node/TypeScript monorepo (Vitest unit projects plus a browser e2e project in the slow tier), I moved documentation out of a large `AGENTS.md`. To follow the move, I also changed one comment line in each of seven `.ts` files: two source files, three test files and two testkits. No code changed.

After that edit, Squeal queued about 16,800 tests (about 820 test files) at revision 11. The slow tier waited behind that backlog for about an hour. One browser spec that the documentation move did break (the served repo clone gained three entries in a list) stayed pending at the revision I pushed, so the failure was found in CI instead of locally.

### What you expected

An edit that changes only comments (or only whitespace) in a TypeScript file does not invalidate the results of the tests that import it, or at least ranks those tests after the tests whose inputs changed in behavior. The slow tier then reaches the specs that read the changed non-code files (Markdown, skill folders) much sooner.

### Command and output

```text
SQUEAL · revision 11 · 31056287 + 11, dirty (changed .ai/ast-grep/rules/…, .ai/skills/campaign/references/cleanup-worker-brief.md, … and 25 more): 16823 pending (16003 tests, 820 test files loaded). Test files without checks: 11 pending.
Slow tier: 87 test files; 87 pending, waiting for fast test files.

$ squeal status packages/web/e2e/workflows.e2e.ts
Pending (1):
  1 slow, behind the fast backlog, run after the fast tests or on `squeal run --slow`: e2e: packages/web/e2e/workflows.e2e.ts
Named test files have no verdict: 1 test file still pending at revision 14
```

### Squeal version

0.1.392

### Squeal revision

11 (the comment-only edits) to 14 (the push)

### Harness

Claude Code

### Model

claude-opus-5-5

### Cost

One extra CI round (about 25 minutes) and a local red/green reproduction that Squeal's slow tier could have given before the push.

### Did a daemon restart clear it?

Not tried

### Suggested fix

Compare the edited file's tokens with comments and whitespace removed against the last run's version. When they are equal, keep the dependents' results current. Related: hearsay-tools/squeal#110 (run named slow files after the current fast tier), which would also have helped here.
title: Comment-only edits to TypeScript files re-queue every dependent test and delay the slow tier
